test_solution.preparation: Deaerated 5% NaCl solution; percentage basis, gas used for deaeration, duration and numerical pH are not specified for the potential test.

test_method.procedure_description: Potentiostat, SCE reference and platinum counter electrode; anodic sweep at 20 mV/min in deaerated 5% NaCl at 60 °C. Figure 6 base metal, without the H2S addition shown in the paired series. Initial hold and starting potential are not specified. FeCl3 CPT, ASTM boiling-acid corrosion and stressed autoclave procedures are separate tests.
test_method.pitting_criterion: Vc′: potential at which anodic current density increases dramatically because of pitting; no fixed numerical current threshold is supplied.

experiments.result_note: Approximate manual Epit reading. Alloy identity follows the N content in Table 1; source criterion is the potential of dramatic anodic current increase. Table 1 gives bulk mass %; Fe balance is not printed and is not calculated. Preparation heating temperatures are distinct from the 60 °C test. NaCl percentage basis is not upgraded to wt%, chloride molarity is not calculated, and the SCC-autoclave nitrogen/vacuum preparation is not assigned to the pitting cell.
